string-array.item: Bionic Linker Isolation: Glibc library path strictly segregated; eliminates bad ELF magic crashes (2f2a2047) on python3.11.
GNU ld Script Purge: Auto-removes non-ELF glibc linker scripts so native Termux tools load cleanly via Bionic.
Full Python & Node Execution: Hermes agent runs Python 3.11 scripts, web servers, and shell commands without library collisions.
Sovereign Hinglish Persona Locked: Hermes communicates strictly in Roman Hinglish with Boss (Radhe Solanki) with full autonomous ownership.
